run_process_sab: run process_sab.py with a job_id argument to resize and copy images to the train split
create_image_splits: create train, test, and val directories for splitting image datasets
resize_images_parallel: resize images to 256x256 and copy them in parallel using multiprocessing Pool
chunk_image_dataset: chunk a list of image files into equal-sized jobs for distributed processing
skip_processed_images: skip images that already exist in the destination directory during processing
